name: Vilnius Gediminas Technical University
overview:
Vilnius Gedimas Technical University (VGTU) is a leader in the technology sector.


Scientific research is carried out in:

  • 14 institutes
  • 2 research centers
  • 34 research laboratories

The University is located in Vilnius, Lithuania.

VGTU is proud of:

  • Its laboratory for mobile applications, the largest in Lithuania
  • Its "Creativity and Innovation Center"


In partnership with more than 500 international institutions, VGTU offers a wide choice of studies in English.

In 2017–2018, VGTU was ranked:

  • 551–600th place by the QS World University Rankings
  • 43rd place by the QS University Rankings: Emerging Europe and Central Asia 2015–2016

administrative:
1) Application Dossier

Once the IR office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.

All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet — please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport or national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).
  • For non-European students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to verify the visa process and fees.
Students in France can use this website:
https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European Students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual.

This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance in Europe.

  • To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure.
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your home within two weeks.
  • You can also download it online.
For more information:
https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For Non-European Students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.

Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) Platform

Please register via the Ariane platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country (for French citizens only):

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html

Campus Life

Housing Options

Students can choose between:

  • University dormitory
  • Renting an apartment

University Dormitory

The dormitory is located on the University campus.

It takes about 7–10 minutes on foot to reach the University.

Addresses:

  • Dormitory No 6, Saulėtekio al. 39 A, Vilnius
  • Dormitory No 1, Saulėtekio al. 25, Vilnius

Prices for VGTU Student Hostels:

The price for one person per month is between 140 and 150 euros.

Off-Campus Accommodation

It is also possible to:

  • Rent an apartment in town:
  • Price for a one-room apartment is between 150 and 300 euros per month
  • Stay in a hotel

courses:
You must take enough courses to obtain 30 ECTS credits per semester, i.e. 60 ECTS credits for the year.

The courses are relatively theoretical and academic.

You can find the academic calendar here.

Courses

You can follow the courses of the Master Information and Information Technologies Security major.

Please note the course "Malware analysis methods" is not available in English.

More information here.

You will also have the opportunity to take Lithuanian classes as well as some minor Business Management (bachelor) courses (VVFRB).

Attendance and Course List

We remind you that attendance is compulsory, under penalty of exclusion from the university.

The course list is given to you for information purposes.

It can change from year to year.

If a class is not available when you arrive on site, EPITECH cannot be held responsible.

EIP

EIP: Any tech4 abroad involves an EIP!

Take advantage of the free slots you will have to advance them.
cost:
The local currency is the euro.

The standard of living in Lithuania is lower than in France.

To give you an idea, here are some examples:

  • Accommodations (student dormintory): 150 - 250 € per month (note, some rooms are not very good)
  • Apartment rental: 200 - 400 € / month
  • Food ~ 200 € / month
  • Meal at the university restaurant: 2-3 EUR
  • Transport per month with subscription: 6 EUR (with student card or ISIC card)
  • Cinema: 6 EUR
  • Tea / coffee: EUR 1 (in a cafe)
  • A4 photocopy / print: EUR 0.03
  • Academic expenses Approx. 15 € per month
